{{Infobox auto}}
The '''hatchet''' is an iron axe with [[Bloodrage]] I, sold by the [[Lumberjack|lumberjack]]. It chops at speed 10, faster than a [[diamond axe]], and hits for {{Hp|9}} at an attack speed of 1, which makes it a strong early weapon as well as a woodcutting tool.

== Obtaining ==
=== Trading ===
An expert-level (level 4) lumberjack sells it for one [[Obol|obol]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/leatherworker/4/hatchet.json}}</ref>

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
It deals 9 damage with an attack speed of 1 and mines axe blocks at speed 10. It keeps the vanilla iron axe's durability (250) and repair material (iron ingots). Its lore uses the old emoji format.
